answer: Use a coastal audit license. A newcomer pays a $120 exam fee and trains for one week, then completes 12 supervised site audits in 60 days: four at a harbor terminal, four at a reef plot, and four on a bridge route. Each audit needs a geotagged photo, a report, and sign-off from an established auditor, and fake reports burn the deposit and ban the profile for 90 days. Forging 1,000 identities costs $120,000 in fees plus 12,000 in-person site visits and two months of supervised field work. Trust here works like a pilot's logbook: only voyages actually sailed get stamped.
